claims.assertion: Anéeka says Taygeta cannot intervene further without being seen as invasive; she accuses the Federation of controlling Earth and says its response is insufficient.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says other benevolent races also continue limited efforts.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says extraterrestrial allies mainly guide starseeds and influence society through ideas, while humans must take responsibility for Earth’s problems.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She rejects waiting passively for outside rescue.

claims.assertion: Anéeka describes humanity as a multi-species experiment sharing a common Earth body-suit, which makes humans one race from within.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

proposed_topics.name: Humanity as a multi-species experiment
aliases: humanidad como experimento de varias razas
